itemstatus.title: Status
itemstatus.remarks: The current status of the item such as ACTIVE, PENDING, PLANNING, PENDOBS and OBSELETE.

pluscisinhousecal.title: Internal Calibration
pluscisinhousecal.remarks: When selected, indicates that this tool is calibrated in house. This field can be used to sort tools that are calibrated internally or externally.

issue2yrago.title: 2 Years Ago
issue2yrago.remarks: Quantity of this tool that was issued two years ago, over a calendar year.

receipttolerance.title: Receipt Tolerance %
receipttolerance.remarks: The percentage value of items that can be received over the amount set in the initial agreement.

plusgchemitem.title: Chemical Item
plusgchemitem.remarks: Indicates whether this item is a chemical.

issue1yrago.title: Last Year
issue1yrago.remarks: Quantity of this tool that was issued last year, over the calendar year.

plusproc.title: Procurement Class
plusproc.remarks: This field displays the quality level required by engineering for procurement and replacement.

plusgrestrcttype.title: Restriction Type
plusgrestrcttype.remarks: The category of restricted chemicals to which this chemical belongs.

binnum.title: Default Bin
binnum.remarks: Identifies the primary bin or storage location for the selected tool within a storeroom.

maxissue.title: Maximum Quantity Issued
maxissue.remarks: Total maximum quantity that can be issued to an asset.

groupname.title: Group
groupname.remarks: Meter group for the item.  This attribute pertains to rotating items only, and is used to set the GroupName attribute of the new asset created from this item during the application of an item assembly structure.

taxexempt.title: Tax Exempt
taxexempt.remarks: Select this check box if the item, the tool, or the service is not taxable. The buyer for your organization determines the tax-exempt status of items, of tools, and of services.

pluscismteclass.title: M&TE Classification
pluscismteclass.remarks: When the Is M&TE? field is checked then you have the option to choose a classification for M&TE.

costtype.title: Issue Cost Type
costtype.remarks: The issue cost type of an inventory item can be Average, Standard or Asset. You use the Asset cost type for rotating items only.

iscrew.title: Crew
iscrew.remarks: Specifies whether the tool can be used in Crew applications and Work Order Tracking applications. If the check box is selected, the tool can be used. If the check box is cleared, the tool cannot be used.

issue3yrago.title: Issued 3 Years Ago
issue3yrago.remarks: Number Of Items Issued 3 Years Ago

itemnum3.title: Item
itemnum3.remarks: Identifies the item record. This value must be unique for all item records. Click the Detail Menu button to view items by classification or availability.

status.title: Status
status.remarks: The current status of the item such as ACTIVE, PENDING, PLANNING, PENDOBS and OBSELETE.

manufacturer.title: Manufacturer
manufacturer.remarks: Identifies the manufacturer of the tool for a particular vendor. Click the Detail Menu button to view a list of companies or go to the Companies applications.

vendor.title: Primary Vendor
vendor.remarks: Code from the Companies application for the primary vendor that supplies this tool. Click the Detail Menu button to view a list of companies or go to the Companies application.

consignment.title: Consignment
consignment.remarks: Select this check box to identify the item as a consignment type of item.

plusdcuesalvagepct.title: Salvage Percentage (CUE)
plusdcuesalvagepct.remarks: Salvage percent of this item. The value is used in calculating the salvage amount on the Costs subtab of the Estimate Request tab in the CU Estimating application. To determine this value, analyze historical jobs to compare the quantity removed during a certain period to the quantity removed that were returned to a storeroom for salvage.

attachonissue.title: Attach to Parent Equipment on Issue
attachonissue.remarks: Attach to parent equipment on issue

plusautobuy.title: Auto-Buy
plusautobuy.remarks: When selected, this item may be purchased without the consent of the procurement-engineering group

itemstatusdate.title: Status Date
itemstatusdate.remarks: Date the work order status was last changed.

statusdate.title: Status Date
statusdate.remarks: Date the work order status was last changed.

plusgsafetycritical.title: Safety-Critical
plusgsafetycritical.remarks: Indicates whether this item is associated with safety-critical equipment.

catalogcode.title: Catalog #
catalogcode.remarks: Primary vendor catalog number or product list number for the tool.

plusdcueuom.title: Unit of Measure
plusdcueuom.remarks: Unit of measure for the item when it is used on CU records.

invptol.title: Plus Count Tolerance
invptol.remarks: Percentage by which a physical count can be above the adjusted balance and still be reconciled. An item's tolerance values are storeroom-specific. Maximo uses tolerance settings to determine the accuracy of the physical count. Maximo uses the tolerance value, established in the Organizations application, as the default value, unless you enter a value in the Plus Count Tolerance field on the Inventory tab.

pluscismte.title: Is M&TE
pluscismte.remarks: Defines whether a Tool is a standard used for measuring and testing equipment.

icg.title: Count Group
icg.remarks: Count group identifier assigned to an item for selecting items by groups, for a count book in Count Books app.

dfltstagebin.title: Default Stage Bin
dfltstagebin.remarks: The Default Staging bin for this inventory item.

frequency.title: Frequency
frequency.remarks: The numeric frequency value of the period to create invoices for the consumption of consignment items.

iskit.title: Kit
iskit.remarks: is this item a kit, or collection of items defined in the ItemStruct table

issueytd.title: Year to Date
issueytd.remarks: Quantity of the tool that has been issued so far this year.

lastissuedate.title: Last Issue Date
lastissuedate.remarks: Calendar date the tool was last issued from the storeroom.

siteid.title: Site
siteid.remarks: Identifies the site of the storeroom where the tool is stocked. Click the Select Value button to view a list of valid sites.

modelnum.title: Model
modelnum.remarks: Model number for the item from the primary vendor.

plusgrestricteduse.title: Restricted Use
plusgrestricteduse.remarks: Indicates whether the use of this item is restricted.

plusdcueunitcost.title: Unit Cost (CUE)
plusdcueunitcost.remarks: Unit cost to be used when estimating the CU.  This value is manually set during implementation by calculating the weighted average cost across the storerooms that carry the item.

itemnum.title: Tool
itemnum.remarks: Indentifies the inventory number for this tool. Click the Detail Menu button to view a list of valid tools, search for a tool by classification, or view a tool's availability.

inspectionrequired.title: Inspection Required
inspectionrequired.remarks: Indicates whether inspection of item is required upon receipt.

metername.title: Meter
metername.remarks: Meter associated with the item.  This is the meter for which a reading is to be recorded when this item is issued to an asset.  Only non-rotating items can be associated with a meter.

itemsetid.title: Item Set
itemsetid.remarks: Identifies the item set, or group of items, to which this tool belongs.

hardresissue.title: Requires hard reservation on use
hardresissue.remarks: Indicates whether a hard reservation must be referenced when the item is issued from a storeroom.

storelocsiteid.title: Storeroom Site
storelocsiteid.remarks: Identifies the site where the storeroom is located.

abctype.title: ABC Type
abctype.remarks: Identifies the type of inventory, telling you which inventory items represent your company's greatest investment in terms of monetary value and turnover rate. MAXIMO sets the type to A, B, or C based on a percentage that the system administrator sets in MultiSite. You can set the ABC type to N, for no category, to exclude this item from the ABC analysis. Click the Select Value button to view the list of types.

plusdtool.title: Use with T&D
plusdtool.remarks: Specifies whether the tool can be used in T&D applications. If the check box is  selected, the tool can be used with T&D applications. If the check box is cleared, the tool cannot be used.

reorder.title: Reorder
reorder.remarks: Specify whether to include the item in the inventory reorder process.

issueunit3.title: Issue Unit
issueunit3.remarks: Unit of measure used to issue the item from the storeroom, such as EACH or ROLL. Click the Select Value button to choose an issue unit.

issueunit.title: Issue Unit
issueunit.remarks: Standard quantity by which the tool is issued from the storeroom, such as each or roll. Click the Select Value button to view a list of valid issue units.

nextinvoicedate.title: Next Invoice Date
nextinvoicedate.remarks: The next date that an invoice will be generated if one is needed. When the Frequency and Frequency Units fields are specified, the Next Invoice Date will default based on the current date/time plus the frequency.

plusabuy.title: Auto buy
plusabuy.remarks: When selected, this item may be purchased without the consent of the procurement-engineering group  For new inventory records this will be defaulted from the corresponding item master. Changes to item master will not get reflected here though

sparepartautoadd.title: Automatically Add as Spare
sparepartautoadd.remarks: Indicates that the item is eligible to be added automatically as a spare part.

invmtol.title: Minus Count Tolerance
invmtol.remarks: Percentage by which a physical count can be below the adjusted balance and still be reconciled. Maximo uses tolerance settings to determine the accuracy of the physical count. An item's tolerance values are storeroom-specific. Maximo uses the tolerance value established in the Organizations application as the default value, unless you enter a value in the Minus Count Tolerance field on the Inventory tab.

plusdmajormatl.title: Major
plusdmajormatl.remarks: Boolean indicator to identify  major material items.  These items are commonly referred to as property units.

consvendor.title: Consignment Vendor
consvendor.remarks: The vendor that is responsible for replenishing the consignment items. Purchase orders and invoices are generated for the vendor that is specified in this field.

invgentype.title: Invoice Generation Type
invgentype.remarks: You can specify how the invoice is generated for the current item. You can specify that invoices are generated based on consumption or on frequency or that they are generated manually.

orderunit3.title: Order Unit
orderunit3.remarks: Unit Of Order. A unit can be each, box, roll, linear feet, cubic feet, square feet etc. For example, 1 box is 1 unit, but the box may be a part of a larger inventory issue element, perhaps a case or crate.

frequnit.title: Frequency Units
frequnit.remarks: The unit of measure for the frequency value.

location.title: Storeroom
location.remarks: Location where the tool is stored. Click the Detail Menu button to view a list of valid storerooms, go to the Storerooms application, or view the Illustrated Parts Catalog.

category.title: Stock Category
category.remarks: Indicates type of stock for the item: stocked (STK), non-stocked (NS), or special order (SP). Click the Select Value button to view the list of stock categories.
